Propagate actual errors and join results through ConfiguredMcpRuntime, McpRuntime, McpConnectionSet, AsyncManagedClient and RmcpClient. Preserve original transport/config selection, no reconnect/new authority/new peer, and the original absolute phase end.

At the actual creation/owner sites, retain the shutdown task, any local stderr reader, process-group escalation task and real transport/service termination result in cancellation-safe custody. An outer wait cancellation may close/fault, but must not discard the only join handles.

For local child ownership, use the original Child/transport and awaited process exit, not a reconstructed PID or terminated boolean. Do not issue signals to an invented process or assert descendant-group death from direct child exit. Exact rmcp dependency APIs must be inspected before implementing the Legacy/service branch.

For executor ownership, distinguish the actual terminate request from the original terminal Exited/result and wait for the latter through its existing capability. For HTTP/in-process selected servers, account for actual local service/tasks without pretending to own or terminate the independent remote server.
